hubBaseUrl.title: Source Scan Hub base URL
hubBaseUrl.description: Published Lovable app URL, for example https://source-scan-hub.lovable.app

workerToken.title: Worker token
workerToken.description: Must match SOURCE_WORKER_TOKEN configured on Source Scan Hub server

lane.title: Worker lane
lane.description: Which worker lane this run should process.

maxItems.title: Maximum queue items per run
maxItems.description: Maximum queue items processed in a single run.

idlePollMs.title: Idle poll delay (ms)
idlePollMs.description: Delay between polls when the queue is empty.

emptyPollLimit.title: Empty polls before exit
emptyPollLimit.description: Number of consecutive empty polls before the run exits.
